nodes.label: File a Complaint Form - Service Portal UI
nodes.description: Screenshot of a service portal complaint submission page at services.networkingexperts.in. The UI features three top-level navigation tabs: 'New Request', 'Track Request', and 'Complaint' (currently active, highlighted in green). The main content area shows a 'File a complaint' form with a subtitle explaining that the ticket is verified against the user's mobile number before forwarding to the team. The form contains three input fields: 'Ticket number' (placeholder: NE-260506-1234), 'Phone number' (placeholder: +91 98765 43210 with Indian country code), and 'What's the issue?' (a textarea with placeholder describing common issues like the issue came back, technician didn't show, billing was wrong). A green 'Submit complaint →' CTA button appears at the bottom of the form. The left side contains an ad placeholder area. The bottom footer shows 'NEED URGENT SUPPORT? +91 88991 33144' with 'Call' and 'WhatsApp' contact buttons. Overall design uses a green accent color scheme on a light background.
ui_patterns: input validation with ticket number and phone
urgent support footer with call/whatsapp CTAs
design_decisions: Green as primary accent color for active states and CTA
Three-tab structure: New Request / Track Request / Complaint
Indian phone number input with +91 country code pre-filled
Mobile-number-based ticket verification for fraud prevention
Dual contact options: Call and WhatsApp in footer
nodes.purpose: Allow customers to file complaints about prior service requests, linking complaints to existing tickets via ticket number and phone number verification
